fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Switch Lumen Shelf on or off for everyone.

fields.label: Restock from
fields.options:
Transfer first, then buy
Buy from supplier
Transfer from main warehouse
fields.description: Where a shortage in an outlet is filled from.

fields.label: Days of cover
fields.description: A suggestion buys or moves enough for this many days of sales, after the lead time.

fields.label: Safety level
fields.description: The higher it is, the more safety stock is kept for items whose sales swing.

fields.label: Supplier lead time (days)
fields.description: Used until a supplier has a Purchase Receipt against a Purchase Order. After that the lead time is learned from those receipts.

fields.label: Transfer lead time (days)
fields.description: Days for a transfer from another warehouse to reach the shelf.

fields.label: Weeks of sales history
fields.description: Recent weeks weigh more. Days an item was out of stock are left out.

fields.label: Respect shelf capacity
fields.description: Uses ERPNext's Putaway Rules (how much of an item a warehouse can hold): a suggestion never fills a warehouse above it. Without a rule, nothing changes.

fields.label: Suggest transfers between outlets
fields.description: Surplus in one outlet covers a shortage in another before anything is bought, and stock that does not sell in one outlet moves to where it sells.

fields.label: Days in stock needed before judging an outlet
fields.description: An outlet gives stock away, or counts as slow, only after it has had the item on the shelf for this many days.

fields.label: Show stock health
fields.description: Slow movers, overstock and the ABC ranking.

fields.label: Slow when stock lasts more than (days)
Overstock when stock lasts more than (days)
Adjust for seasons
fields.description: Learns from last year's sales of the same item in the same weeks. A season that sold more last year raises the suggestion before it starts.

fields.label: Seasons follow
fields.description: Gregorian for dates that repeat every year (school, year end). Hijri for Ramadan and Eid. Choose automatically uses the one that predicted your last 8 weeks best.

fields.label: Show rising and falling items
fields.description: Compares the recent half of the sales history with the earlier half.

fields.label: Learn from promotions
fields.description: Days sold mostly at a discount are left out of the normal sales, the lift is measured, and a planned promotion (an ERPNext pricing rule with an end date, or a LumenPOS promotion) raises the suggestion before it starts.

fields.label: Show lost sales
fields.description: What an outlet would have sold on the days an item was out of stock.

fields.label: Plan purchases within a budget
fields.description: Adds a budget filter to Running low: the most urgent and most valuable purchases come first.

fields.label: Show forecast accuracy
fields.description: Compares what was forecast 14 days ago with what was sold since.

fields.label: Forecast by demand pattern
fields.description: An item that sells now and then is forecast by the size of its sales and the gaps between them, not by a plain average.

fields.label: Forecast new items from similar ones
fields.description: An item with under 14 days in stock takes the typical daily sales of items of the same brand and group in the same warehouse.

fields.label: Watch expiry dates
fields.description: Never plans more than sells within an item's shelf life, and shows stock in batches that will expire before it sells.

fields.label: Suggest what to do with stock that does not sell
fields.description: Move it where it sells, return it to the supplier, sell it together with an item bought with it, or discount it.

fields.label: Show assortment gaps
fields.description: Items that sell in one outlet and that another outlet does not carry.

fields.label: Create material requests from the suggestions
fields.description: A button on Running low and Transfer suggestions makes ERPNext Material Requests: purchases one per supplier, transfers one per sending warehouse.

fields.label: Submit the requests
fields.description: Off: they are saved as drafts for someone to check and submit. ERPNext counts a request as on order once it is submitted.

fields.label: Keep ERPNext's reorder levels up to date
fields.description: Every night Lumen Shelf sets each item's reorder level and quantity per warehouse from its forecast, and ERPNext raises the material requests itself. A level you set yourself is kept. Switching this off removes the levels Lumen Shelf set.

fields.label: Daily alert to Shelf Managers
fields.description: A bell notification after each update: what changed and how many items are running low.

fields.label: Suggest trending products
fields.description: Products rising in Google searches, in your country and worldwide, that you do not sell yet. Uses Lumen's AI service (below). Only the names of your item groups and items are sent, never quantities, prices or customers.

fields.label: Credit balance (USD)
fields.description: Prepaid credit on Lumen's trends service, used once the free allowance of the month is spent.

fields.label: Warehouse roles
fields.description: Optional. Every warehouse is an outlet unless named here. The main warehouse is found from the transfers it sends, unless one is named.

fields.label: Suggest bundles
fields.description: Pairs of items your customers buy together that make a natural set, with a name and a price, made into an ERPNext Product Bundle in one click. Uses Lumen's AI service (below). Only item names and item groups are sent.

fields.label: Bundle discount (%)
fields.description: The bundle price is the two prices less this.

fields.label: Minimum profit on a bundle (%)
fields.description: The discount is made smaller when needed so the bundle keeps at least this profit on its cost.

fields.label: Ask for new bundle ideas now
Lumen's AI service
fields.description: Used by trending products and bundle ideas. The URL and keys come from Lumen.
